question:
Select the most appropriate word for the given group of words.

Difficult to interpret or understand
solution:
The correct answer is **'Option 3'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **given group of words describes **something that is challenging to comprehend or interpret.(समझना मुश्किल).
 
• The correct word** "Enigmatic"** refers to something mysterious, puzzling, or difficult to understand.(रहस्यमय, अस्पष्ट).

Therefore, the** correct answer** is- **'Enigmatic'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Option 1: **"Explicable" **means able to be accounted for or understood.(समझाया जा सकने वाला).
 
• Option 2: **"Emulate"** means to match or surpass, typically by imitation.(अनुकरण करना, प्रतिस्पर्धा करना).
 
• Option 4: **"Endemic"** refers to something regularly found among particular people or in a certain area.(स्थानिक, स्वदेशी).

3d:Ta2b,
The correct answer is** 'Option 4'**
